fields.name: origins
fields.label: Origins
fields.description: Comma-separated airports, the first is shown first, e.g. Bangkok (BKK), Chiang Mai (CNX), Phuket (HKT). With one origin there is no picker.

fields.name: source
fields.label: Fares address
fields.description: The fares service (/common/calendarPricing/popular-fares, production domain only) or a published sheet ending in .json.

fields.name: limit
fields.label: Maximum fares
fields.description: Optional. Empty shows every fare returned.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Book link
fields.description: Where Book now goes. Optional placeholders: {origin}, {destination}, {date}, {returnDate}, {journey}, e.g. /en-th/book/book-flight?from={origin}&to={destination}.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Shown before the origin, e.g. Trending destinations from.

fields.name: from
fields.label: Origin field label
fields.description: Names the origin picker for screen readers, e.g. From.

fields.name: to
fields.label: Destination label
fields.description: Shown above each city, e.g. To.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price text
fields.description: {currency} and {price} are filled in, e.g. From {currency} {price}*. The * refers to the fare note authored after the block.

fields.name: previous
fields.label: Previous button label
fields.description: Screen-reader name of the scroll-back button.

fields.name: next
fields.label: Next button label
fields.description: Screen-reader name of the scroll-forward button.
